europe_now.title: Germany Blames Russia for Airport Drone Attack
europe_now.summary: Germany has officially blamed Russia for an explosive-laden drone incident at Leipzig airport and responded by ordering the closure of a Russian consulate. The security breach has triggered retaliatory diplomatic measures and heightened geopolitical tensions across Europe.

sources.headline: Germany blames Russia for airport drone incident, hits back with sanctions
Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack

europe_now.title: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham Faces Parliament
europe_now.summary: Newly appointed UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has made his debut in the House of Commons to outline his legislative agenda and face lawmakers. Burnham used his initial address to pledge hope and detail his administration's priorities amidst mounting political realities.

sources.headline: Burnham pledges to restore hope as he makes his House of Commons debut as UK leader

top_stories.title: German Response to Airport Drone Attack
top_stories.summary: German authorities have formally attributed the recent explosive-laden drone attack at Leipzig airport to Russia. In response to the security breach, the government announced immediate retaliatory measures including the closure of a Russian consulate.

top_stories.title: UK Parliamentary Developments
top_stories.summary: Andy Burnham appeared before the House of Commons for the first time as the newly appointed UK leader. During the session, he pledged to restore hope while addressing lawmakers on his government's upcoming policy agenda.
